articles.summary: Philip Rivers, who came out of retirement this week to help the Colts address their void at quarterback, is expected to start Sunday against the Seahawks, a source told ESPN.

articles.summary: The 49ers placed Brandon Aiyuk on the reserve/left team list on Saturday, likely ending the receiver's tenure in San Francisco.

articles.title: Bears place CB Gordon (groin) on injured reserve
articles.summary: Chicago veteran cornerback Kyler Gordon was placed on injured reserve by the Bears on Saturday, and the 25-year-old nickel corner will miss the remainder of the regular season after he sustained a groin injury at Lambeau Field back on Dec. 7.

articles.title: McCaffrey added to injury report, expected to play
articles.summary: 49ers running back Christian McCaffrey is expected to play vs. the Titans on Sunday, a source said, despite being added to the injury report as questionable.

articles.title: Cowboys keep CB Diggs on IR for Vikings game
articles.summary: The Cowboys did not activate CB Trevon Diggs from IR for Sunday's game against the Vikings despite his participation in practice this week.

articles.title: Sources: Bears optimistic Odunze will return Sun.
